data.title: WONIK Discloses Quarterly Affiliate Transactions and Guarantees
data.description:
The latest update is out from WONIK HOLDINGS CO., LTD. ( (KR:030530) ).

The WONIK group includes activities involving semiconductor and display manufacturing equipment, quartz rings and semiconductor materials; WONIK Holdings is its representative company. The quarterly disclosure reported no changes in circular shareholding among domestic affiliates, no voting-rights exercise by financial and insurance companies, and no shareholders’ meetings for the investments shown; ownership ratios ranged from 69.71% to 88.75% where reported.

data.title: Sarama Reports Arbitration Progress and Cosmo Drilling
data.description:
Sarama Resources ( (TSE:SWA) ) has issued an announcement.

Sarama’s arbitration against Burkina Faso arises from what the company describes as the unlawful expropriation of its Tankoro 2 Exploration Permit, a central component of the Sanutura Gold Project. The company updated damages sought to US$245.3 million plus interest, while its quantum expert assessed the total claim at US$326.8 million including pre-award interest as of 31 July 2026.

The merits hearing is scheduled for 22–26 February 2027, with Burkina Faso’s rejoinder due 1 December 2026; no date has been set for the final award. Riedel began reconnaissance drilling at Cosmo on 1 November 2026, the first drilling there in more than 30 years, while Sarama retained an approximate 32% stake with scope to reach approximately 44% if performance rights vest and are exercised.

data.title: Metro Mining Agrees Senior Debt Amortisation Restructure
data.description:
Metro Mining Limited ( (AU:MMI) ) has shared an announcement.

Metro Mining is an independent bauxite producer and explorer operating its 100%-owned Bauxite Hills Mine in Far North Queensland. It produces high-alumina bauxite for direct shipment to customers, with bauxite used to make aluminium.

Metro agreed with Nebari to restructure amortisation of the largest senior-debt tranche, about US$17.8 million, making it interest-only until a bullet payment in December 2027; about US$23.2 million remains to be amortised across the two tranches. Other facility terms, including the coupon rate, remain unchanged.
